title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: McIlroy’s 11-Birdie Comeback
items.text: Rory McIlroy overcame a two-shot penalty for improving his lie to shoot a career-best 9-under 63 with 11 birdies at the Abu Dhabi Aldar Championship, moving to one shot behind the 12-under leaders.

items.headline: LIV Golf Shuts Down
items.text: LIV Golf ended after five years and a $5 billion spend when Saudi PIF stopped funding and a rescue deal collapsed, causing uncertain futures for stars like Jon Rahm and Bryson DeChambeau.
